newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's AIE to propose sale 35 pct CSI to Arbed.
newsitem.headline: Spain's AIE to propose sale 35 pct CSI to Arbed.

text.p: Spanish state holding firm Agencia Industrial de Estado (AIE) said it would propose the government approve the sale of 35 percent of steel firm Corporacion Siderurgica Integral (CSI) to Luxembourg steel maker Arbed.
"The Agencia Industrial will propose the offer from Arbed as partner, but it will be the government who decides," a spokesperson from AIE said.
AIE would not give further details, but said a news conference would be held at noon (1000 GMT).
The government has received two competiting offers for CSI from French steel group Usinor and Arbed.
Industry Minister Josep Pique said last week the government may approve the sale at its cabinet meeting on August 1.

After the sale of this 35 percent stake, Spain is expected to offer another stake of between 10 and 25 percent of CSI to non-technological parters, which could be domestic or international financial entities.
The third step is a public share offering for the remaining tranche, between 40 and 55 percent, probably in the autumn.
